prefill.description: Pass either 'viewRef' OR the combination of 'fetchXml' + 'entityLogicalName'. All fields are optional but one of these two forms must be present for the tool to pre-populate.

fetchXml.description: Serialized FetchXML query string. Required when viewRef is not provided.

entityLogicalName.description: Root entity logical name, e.g. 'account'. Required when viewRef is not provided.

viewRef.description: EntityReference to an existing view. When provided, fetchXml and entityLogicalName are derived from the view. Mutually exclusive with fetchXml + entityLogicalName.

entityLogicalName.description: Dataverse entity logical name: savedquery = system/public view; userquery = personal view.
